title: CloudHSM: your own dedicated key hardware

kcs.statement: AWS CloudHSM provides dedicated, single-tenant hardware security modules in your VPC, validated at FIPS 140 Level 3, where only you manage the keys and HSM users (AWS cannot access the keys). Use it when a regulation requires customer-controlled HSMs.

problem_ideas: A bank's regulator says no cloud provider staff may be able to access its keys. Choose between KMS and CloudHSM.
Identify the keyword in this question that points to CloudHSM: 'single-tenant, FIPS 140 Level 3 HSM'.
Who manages HSM users and keys in CloudHSM? Who manages them in KMS?
A team wants automatic integration with 100+ AWS services and the least operational work. Pick KMS or CloudHSM.
True or false: if you lose your CloudHSM credentials, AWS can recover your keys.
Where does a CloudHSM cluster run: in your VPC, at an edge location or in AWS's shared fleet?
